in_marathi.name: Hiyaavi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hiyaavi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hiyaavi is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, which means 'Goddess of Knowledge'. In Hindu mythology, Hiyaavi is associated with the goddess Saraswati, who is the goddess of wisdom, knowledge, music, and art. The name represents the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom, and is believed to bring intelligence, creativity, and enlightenment.
